newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina interior minister hits back at Cavallo.
newsitem.headline: Argentina interior minister hits back at Cavallo.

text.p: Argentine Interior Minister Carlos Corach, stung by accusations against him by former economy chief Domingo Cavallo, hit back Friday saying Cavallo needed psychiatric attention.
Corach, who is already suing Cavallo for accusing him of manipulating judges and blocking investigations into graft, told reporters: "He should be examined psychiatrically."
Asked whether or not he thought Cavallo was mad, Corach replied: "I say he should be examined."

Since his dismissal by President Carlos Menem in July, Cavallo has peppered the government and courts with accusations of corruption, running up more than 20 libel actions in the process. He repeated his charges against Corach to congressmen Thursday.

Cavallo was largely responsible for the reforms that stamped out Argentina's once-rampant inflation. He has recently embarked on a crusade against official corruption, dropping broad hints he may make a bid for the presidency in the 1999 or 2003 elections.
Cavallo has said that Menem would not have appointed him to be minister if he were mad.
